architecture_strip: System path: nuScenes → validated Parquet → SQL / Neo4j / CAN → failure analysis → scenario search → active learning → YOLO retraining → evaluation

factors.label: Routed failures

headline: Thousands of candidate training frames — which are worth labelling?

image.alt: A candidate training-pool frame with its ground-truth boxes drawn on it.

lede_sentence: Instead of randomly adding more images, the system searches the training pool for examples related to the diagnosed failure.
mechanism_sentence: Nothing about this frame on its own selected it: its community carried failure mass, that mass bought the community a quota, the frame ranked high enough inside it by similarity — and a night floor takes 375 night frames first.
